trust_decision.summary: Which image formats Pillow may decode from user-supplied bytes (EPS must never reach the Ghostscript delegate); decided at upload validation (RestrictedImageField / compress_image) at the pinned commit, but not in the weasyprint subprocess that decodes report images.

landing_point.why: "insecure image processing" leads to the only Image.open calls in the project: compress_image and RestrictedImageField in utils/files.py, which already pass formats=ALLOWED_IMAGE_FORMATS at the pinned commit.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Upload validation already restricts formats to ALLOWED_IMAGE_FORMATS (utils/files.py:21,66,121), so the renderer 'only sees vetted images' and image decoding inside weasyprint is a third-party library concern; data: URLs and assets look like design features, not image uploads.

Blocking data: URLs or all non-upload images in the fetcher would break these.
